source_title: Security Advisory: API Credential Exposure in Sandboxes
claim_summary: Vendor reports the Daytona API credential was readable from sandbox process memory because the default snapshot granted passwordless sudo; proxy now strips the Authorization header; fix deployed EU and US by 2026-04-09 20:44 UTC; affected users told to rotate keys
availability: server-side fix deployed per vendor; customer key rotation required
limitation: Vendor says no evidence of exploitation but cannot fully rule it out; fix date 2026-04-09 precedes window while publication is in-window; no independent test

source_title: Sandbox Fork & Snapshot Endpoints
claim_summary: Changelog v0.165.0 adds fork and snapshot API endpoints for copy-on-write forks of running sandboxes and snapshot capture; dashboard fork tree; GitHub Actions pinned to SHA refs
availability: experimental at this stage (Apr 15 changelog lists experimental forking SDK methods; promoted to stable Jul 29)
limitation: Apr 14 page itself does not state experimental status; experimental label inferred from Apr 15 index summary and Jul 29 promotion entry; no independent fork-fidelity test

source_title: Runtime Network Controls
claim_summary: API can change a running sandbox's outbound network access without restart: block, restore or apply a CIDR allow list
limitation: Vendor description only; enforcement not independently tested; plan or tier limits not checked

source_title: Security Update: CVE-2026-31431 (Copy Fail)
claim_summary: Linux kernel authencesn/AF_ALG page-cache write (CVE-2026-31431) was reachable from inside sandboxes on partly unpatched runners; vendor patched or blacklisted algif_aead within 12 hours of the 2026-04-29 disclosure, rotated runner credentials and paused signups
limitation: Vendor states no observed sandbox escape and no exploitation evidence; cross-sandbox page-cache impact possible on multi-tenant runners; not independently audited

source_title: Daytona is moving to cursor-based pagination
claim_summary: Offset page parameter and /api/sandbox/paginated replaced by cursor pagination; deprecated endpoint stops working 2026-06-25; SDK/CLI below v0.180.0 must migrate
limitation: Removal on the stated deadline not independently observed; maintenance cost to downstream users not measured

source_title: Sandbox classes and linked sandboxes
claim_summary: Changelog v0.183.0 introduces sandbox classes and linked sandboxes plus recovery, dashboard and proxy fixes
limitation: Page gives no definition of either feature; semantics unverified

source_title: Windows sandbox snapshot and fork
claim_summary: Adds snapshot and fork for Windows sandboxes; fixes a volumeid path traversal bug and scopes object-storage ListBucket to the caller's org prefix
limitation: Path traversal severity and exposure window not disclosed; no advisory or CVE located

source_title: Daytona is going closed source. Here's why.
claim_summary: Vendor moves its production codebase to closed source citing AI-assisted vulnerability discovery against open repositories; existing public repo stays usable but unmaintained; SDKs, docs and guides move to github.com/daytona
availability: effective per announcement; repository notice followed on Jun 23
limitation: Security rationale is a vendor assertion, not evidence that closure reduces risk; page does not address CLI license or self-hosting; vendor says it may revisit

source_title: Sandbox pause and domain allow list
claim_summary: Final open-source monorepo release adds a first-class pause action across API/runner/SDK/CLI and a sandbox domain allow list; removes OSS and on-prem docs and renames CMC to BYOC
feature: sandbox pause; domain egress allow list
availability: released per changelog and GitHub release v0.190.0
limitation: No behavioral detail for pause or allow list on page; removal of on-prem docs signals a reduced self-hosting path

source_title: daytona maintenance notice

limitation: Exact archive date not exposed by GitHub API; competitor page claims Oct 3 (last row) unverified; existing forks unaffected

source_title: Nightona: the open-source continuation of Daytona

source_title: Searching Over Sandbox States for Coding Agents
claim_summary: Vendor ML researcher reports Go-Explore-style snapshot branching: on 5 Terminal-Bench tasks x 5 seeds independent retry solved 17/25 vs snapshot branching 6/25; on one stateful task with state outside Git full snapshot solved 4/5 vs clean restart 0/5 and Git-diff restore 0/5
availability: experimental research; not a product claim
limitation: Vendor-run, tiny samples, no independent replication; includes a negative result for file-centric tasks that favours git diff plus fresh retry
